title: Technical Due Diligence for Automation Software Vendors
summary: Discord servers reveal the true reliability of software through unfiltered user reports and developer response times.
body_markdown:
## How Activepieces turns community transparency into a roadmap


[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/discord) publishes its development cycle to public scrutiny, with roughly 60% of its integrations contributed by the community itself, ensuring the platform evolves rapidly through decentralized collaboration.


This ensures that deployment risks are identified by the community before they reach your production environment. Unlike closed-source alternatives that hide architectural flaws, this transparency allows a lead engineer to audit the stability of specific connectors by viewing the raw source code on GitHub.


### Real-time bug reporting in the public Discord


The Activepieces Discord server functions as a live audit log where users can see how 24,532 GitHub stars translate into actual peer-to-peer support and configuration edge cases.


Because these discussions are indexed and searchable, a DevOps manager can identify if a specific version of a Google Sheets or Slack connector is currently failing for other users.


### Verifying the 'Time to Fix' through public commit logs


The GitHub repository for Activepieces provides a timestamped record of every code change, allowing prospective buyers to verify the MIT-licensed core and calculate the true velocity of the engineering team.


By comparing the date of a reported issue in the repository to the date of the corresponding pull request, an IT auditor can verify the vendor’s responsiveness without relying on anecdotal sales claims.


The build history in the activepieces/activepieces repository serves as a verifiable roadmap that replaces the typical vendor slide deck.


By examining release tags and merged pull requests, teams can see exactly how MoneyGram and FundingSocieties rely on a platform where **735+ integrations are maintained** with community visibility.


This level of disclosure means you buy a vendor whose past performance is checkable, rather than one whose future promises require a leap of faith.


A granular view of every iteration of an automation is provided by the Version History panel in the Activepieces flow builder, which supports unlimited flows on every plan to ensure teams can iterate without artificial constraints.


A botched update can be reverted to a known stable state immediately.


Moving the automation logic into a version control system is possible via the "Push to Git" feature, where it can be peer-reviewed and audited alongside the rest of the company’s codebase.


### Direct access to the engineers building the connectors


The open-source nature of the project allows your internal developers to communicate directly with the core contributors who write the integration logic.


When a specific API endpoint is missing from a pre-built integration, your team can review the TypeScript files on GitHub to understand the limitation or contribute the necessary code themselves.
